categories.name: Impacts of Extreme Heat in the EU

fun_fact: Desperate times, desperate measures: with a brutal heatwave and drought shrinking the Danube, Romania has resorted to blasting parts of the riverbed to change the course of the river and keep water flowing to its nuclear reactor. [Read more](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/03/romania-blasts-divert-danube-water-nuclear-reactor-energy-crisis-hungary)
